comment: The items RUN_IMG3D.bat makes by default, and what post.py needs per item. Ids and names: tools/item_dossier on
the install (2026-11-16 run): 16 Matchbox, 15 Lamp, 21 Key (the brass key of the candle niche), 17 Book, 1 Shards
and Seals, 4 Statuette (the four lying in the Study), 24 / 25 / 26 Mask, 9 Colt-45, 51 Colt-45 magazine.
metres: the longest side of the real object where a dossier gives it (roth_held.cpp kRealSize: Lamp 30 cm tall,
Matchbox 5.5 cm, Book 20 cm, Key 6 cm); null = not known: the engine sizes the lying item to its picture and the
held one to its card (0.10 m). The Colt's 0.216 m is the M1911's length (reasoning only, not from the game).
hold: palm (lies in the open palm), fist (held in the fist, up along the thumb), hang (hangs from the hand,
upright). grip_frac: the grip point as fractions of the model's box (x left->right, y bottom->top, z back->front);
grip_offset: metres added (palm: -0.025 puts the base 2.5 cm out of the palm from the grip socket).
grip_rot: degrees (yaw about +Y, pitch about +X, roll about +Z). front_yaw: degrees about +Y applied to the
generated mesh before anything else, if the generator's front is not +Z for this item. fill_holes: the film's
ground mask cuts dark glass out as holes (the Lamp); true makes every hole the border cannot reach part of the
nothing here was seen in a headset.
